entry.title: retarget-link.yazi
entry.summary: Edit symlink targets inline, just like renaming files.

entry.title: f3d.yazi
entry.summary: 3D model previewer with orbit, zoom and model stats, powered by f3d. Supports glTF, FBX, OBJ, STL, USD, STEP and more.

entry.title: repo-status.yazi
entry.summary: Show the branch and Git status next to every repository directory in the file list.

entry.title: bifold.yazi
entry.summary: Dual-pane view by splitting the screen between two tabs, with a runtime flip between side-by-side and stacked layouts, pane resizing, and cross-pane copy/move. Fork of split-tabs.yazi with bug fixes.

entry.title: supaline.yazi
entry.summary: Turn the linemode into as many columns as you like (size, timestamps, permissions, owner and more, or your own), each styled its own way, with gradients across the folder.

entry.title: encapsulate.yazi
entry.summary: Move individual selected files into their own self-named directories.

entry.title: epub-preview.yazi
entry.summary: Preview EPUB covers using PyMuPDF, so no Linux-only thumbnailer is needed and it works on macOS too.

entry.title: difftool.yazi
entry.summary: Compare two selected files or directories with your configured `git difftool` (Meld, VS Code, Beyond Compare, vimdiff, …).

entry.title: gridview.yazi
entry.summary: Browse the current folder's images as a thumbnail grid drawn by swayimg, then jump to the one you pick (Wayland only).

entry.title: omniconvert.yazi
entry.summary: A conversion menu that offers only the formats the hovered or selected files can actually become (images, audio, video, PDF and documents), using ImageMagick, FFmpeg and LibreOffice.

entry.title: recents.yazi
entry.summary: Recently used files using the desktop-bookmark-spec (Linux only), supporting viewing, adding and removing.

entry.title: dsh-tui.yazi
entry.summary: Launch dsh-TUI with explicitly selected Yazi files appended to an editable prompt.

entry.title: red-table.yazi
entry.summary: Select images visually in red-table and return the confirmed selection to Yazi.

entry.title: shell-peek.yazi
entry.summary: Peek a shell command's output as a toast without leaving the file list.

entry.title: lsblk-mount.yazi
entry.summary: A fork of the official mount.yazi with lsblk-based device discovery, a mountpoint column, and error notifications.

entry.title: far-too-yazi
entry.summary: FAR Manager / Norton Commander style dual-pane config distribution for yazi (AstroNvim-style, not a single plugin) — instant vim<->FAR mode switching, conflict-aware cross-pane transfers, KDE Connect phone browsing.

entry.title: hxjump.yazi
entry.summary: Helix-like two character jump to any visible file or folder

entry.title: yazi-album-plugin.yazi
entry.summary: Upload selected photos to a cloud album via rclone through a 3-step fzf wizard (provider → remote → album; existing or create-new).
